lines.en: I walk slowly and don't look at you.

lines.zh: 我的红鳞被太阳照得发亮。
lines.en: The sun catches my red scales.
I walk the base of the ruin's wall.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀贴着身子收着。
lines.en: My wings are folded against my sides.
I step through the fallen leaves.
I go around the stone.
I walk into the sun and stop.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，尾巴扫过落叶。
lines.en: I walk slowly, tail sweeping the leaves.
I head deeper into the wood.
I walk so lightly it's almost silent.
I glance back once and walk on.
I head toward water.
I lie with my chin on a claw.

lines.zh: 我身上的鳞一片片松开。
lines.en: My scales relax one by one.
I close my eyes a while.
The wind moves over my wings.
The light here is warm.

lines.zh: 红鳞蹭着树枝，我听见叶响。
lines.en: My red scales brush the branch; I hear leaves stir.
I curl my tail around me.
I'm sunning myself in this patch.

lines.zh: 我一时半会儿不打算动。
lines.en: I don't plan on moving any time soon.
Half asleep, the tip of my tail stirs.
There's a bird up there; I glance at it.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在我旁边的枝上。
lines.en: A bird lands on the branch beside me.
I don't shoo it.
I settle down again.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，我抬头看了看。
lines.en: You're standing there; I look up.

lines.zh: 我趴着，只把眼皮抬了抬。
lines.en: I stay flat and only lift my eyelids.
My head leans your way.
You're a little close to my nest.

lines.zh: 你站着就站着，我不赶你。
lines.en: Stand there if you like; I won't shoo you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土里动了动。
lines.en: My claws shift in the soil.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的烟和铁。
lines.en: I smell smoke and iron on you.
Done looking; I turn back and doze.

lines.zh: 我在看你手里有没有东西。
lines.en: I'm seeing whether you hold anything.
Don't come closer and I won't move.
One wing lifts.
I open my jaws and stretch.
I raise my head and back two paces.
That broke my rest.
I get up, my scales flaring.

lines.zh: 我从鼻子里哼出一口气。
lines.en: I puff a breath out through my nose.
I tuck my wings to my sides.
I give half a step and don't close in.
The wound's shallow; I can't be bothered to rise.
I look at the wound.
I slowly lie down again.
It hurts, and I don't cry out.
I'm looking at that.
I push up on my foreclaws.
I lower my head to sniff.
I bite it; it's very hard.
I don't much care for this.
Go further off, and then I'll come sniff.
I pin it under a claw.

lines.zh: 我吃起来一点也不着急。
lines.en: I eat without any hurry.
When I'm done I lie down again.

lines.zh: 你手里还有别的东西吗。
lines.en: Have you anything else in that hand?
You bump me and I shift.
I don't even lift my body.

lines.zh: 我挪开一点，尾巴扫了扫。
lines.en: I shift aside and sweep my tail.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的尾巴压住了。
lines.en: That pins my tail.
I toss my head once.
I slowly straighten myself.

lines.zh: 你把我的尾巴踩在脚下。
lines.en: You've stepped on my tail.
I draw my claws back slowly.
Woken by the bump, I flick my tail.
I settle back where I was.
She lies beside me.
Her scales are paler than mine.

lines.zh: 她的鳞贴着我的鳞，暖的。
lines.en: Her scales against mine, warm.

lines.zh: 我们挨着，晒同一片太阳。
lines.en: Side by side, we share the same patch of sun.

lines.zh: 她的尾巴搭在我的上面。
lines.en: Her tail lies over mine.
Neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 她打了个哈欠，我也打了。
lines.en: She yawns; so do I.
She covers her head with a wing.

lines.zh: 这一片阳光够我们两个。
lines.en: There's sun enough for both of us.
She falls asleep before I do.
I lower my head and take it.
Something hard; it hurts my teeth.
I chew it slowly.
I set it between my claws.
Nothing to it; I drop it back.

lines.zh: 凑近一闻，一点肉味都没有。
lines.en: One sniff close up: not a trace of meat.

lines.zh: 我用爪子一拨，它滚进草里。
lines.en: One paw-flick, and it rolls into the grass.
Grass seed's in my mouth; I lick it away.
I push it to the edge of my nest.
I lie back down.
I raise my head; I heard that.
I don't get up at once.
I turn my head that way.
This one doesn't look like an egg thief.
I turn my head back again.
My scales lie flat again.
I glance over without getting up.
Its smell isn't sharp.
I slowly relax.
I go on lying there.
It's still some way from me.
That shape's too far off; I'll remember it.
Sunlight lies on my red scales.
I'll hold still and see what it does.
I push myself up and stand.
I take two steps that way.
I lower my head and raise it.
It's standing there without moving.
I don't show my teeth.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，我只想显大些。
lines.en: Wings half spread; I only mean to look bigger.
I stop and look at it.
It moved first.
I give a little ground.
It doesn't follow.

lines.zh: 我伏下去，下巴几乎贴地。
lines.en: I lower myself, chin nearly on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上画着半圈。
lines.en: My tail draws a half circle in the dirt.
There's still some distance between us.
I see no malice in it.
I just stay where I am.
I only raise a claw to block.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一顶，它退了两步。
lines.en: One shove of my shoulder, and it's two steps back.
I don't use my teeth.
I swing my head and knock it aside.
It lunges at me again.

lines.zh: 我尾巴轻轻一摆，扫开了它。
lines.en: A light flick of my tail sweeps it aside.
I draw off a short way.
I open my mouth only to frighten it.
It backs off a few paces at last.
My shoulder takes a knock.
I lift a foreclaw again.
I keep that one light.
It still won't leave.
I lie back down.
I raise my head out of the grass.
Dew still hangs on my red scales.
I sit up slowly.
I don't walk off at once.
The sun is good here.
I look at the ruin's wall.
I try stretching my wings.
I open my mouth in a yawn.
I shift into the sun.
I just lie down there.
There's a sound far off; I ignore it.
My tail sways slowly.
It's quiet in this place.
I close my eyes.
The sun's just right; I won't move.
The sun moves over a little more.
Fire comes near and I shift aside.

lines.zh: 我摔在落叶上，闷响一声。
lines.en: I land in the leaves with a thud.
Water floods my nose and I fight up.
The blast throws me into the grass.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的鳞缝。
lines.en: Something sharp goes between my scales.
The light makes me go tense all over.
Too hungry even to lift my head.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我贴着地不动。
lines.en: The flash pins me flat.
Emptiness below; I fall.
